aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.title: Selected Lambda literal environment variables have no detected secrets
aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.description: Inspect literal environment variables only for explicitly selected Lambda functions using both offline detectors and native current-configuration provenance.
aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected Lambda environment and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Prefer scoped runtime identity or secret references.
aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.purpose: Only selected observed $LATEST environment literals are inspected; no invocation, history, code package, secret-store or credential-validity conclusion.
aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.missing_observation: Selected Lambda environment variables could not be completely read, bound and scanned with both offline detectors.
aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in selected Lambda environment variables.
aws.review.lambda.selected_environment_s.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in selected Lambda environment variables. The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.
